status: registered before fitting or target recommendations
shared_mean_prior: frozen measurement-aware RBF signal kernel plus scalar-intercept uncertainty; frozen scalar-intercept mean; exclude its per-site discrepancy
residual_covariance: a * unit RBF + b * ones + delta * identity; a,b,delta >= 0; frozen source-only lengthscales and response normalizers
initial_residual_parameters: a = frozen signal variance, b = frozen scalar-intercept uncertainty, delta = frozen discrepancy variance
source_likelihood: joint Gaussian marginal likelihood of all six source tasks, integrating the common function mean and independent task residuals; recorded label errors included; Cholesky-whitened common function, no statistical variance floor
target_prior: source-posterior common function mean; full common-function posterior covariance including interpolation, plus independent residual covariance
target_contract: same cached four raw episodes, complete old73-policy bank, shared retained recommendation, guarded/direct action class and362 cap; recommendations saved before cached truth is read
execution: four source head fits once, local serial single-thread; no scheduler, server dispatch or data pulls
interpretation: opened-six-task common-function-mean attribution; not independent confirmation, native HyperBO, generic GP optimality or incremental KG evidence
